QuestInfo.name: [Boss Battle] Zakum
QuestInfo.0:
Deep inside the El Nath Dead Mine, a statue of worship has been corrupted into a thing of terror by the evil Zakum tree. Save the underground tribe by defeating Zakum.

3) Chaos Mode: Lv. 100 - Lv. 250
